title: Common: suspected unstable angina with non-diagnostic initial tests

symptoms: New chest pressure at rest lasting 12 minutes, resolved before assessment; two similar episodes over 24 hours.
Central pressure with radiation to left shoulder; no fever or pleuritic component reported. Symptom pattern is new and increasing in frequency.
history: No known prior MI or coronary intervention
medications: Fictional home list: antihypertensive and lipid-lowering therapy; exact names/adherence to be reconciled
presentation.vitals: HR 88 bpm; BP 142/84 mmHg; RR 18/min; SpO2 98% room air; temperature 36.8 C; alert, no shock signs in initial snapshot.
presentation.initial_ecg_summary: Sinus rhythm; nonspecific ST-T changes; no diagnostic ST elevation. Repeat ECG during recurrent symptoms is not yet available.
presentation.initial_troponin_summary: hs-cTn fictional assay: 0 h below 99th percentile; repeat sample at scenario-defined interval remains below threshold without significant delta. CBC without major abnormality; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; potassium 4.1 mmol/L; glucose 118 mg/dL. These are synthetic values.
